# NTAG424 DNA + NDEF + PN7160 reference survey — read-only-safety & reuse analysis

**Context.** One NTAG424 DNA chip, keys/SDM state unknown. Doctrine: read-only allowlist, default-deny
(ccid-firmware-rs AGENTS.md card-handling doctrine; the 2026-10-12 ISD-lock incident taught that
'authentication-class' commands carry non-renewable budgets). This survey distils five sources into a
SAFE read-only Type-4 APDU profile with exact bytes, a forbidden list, license/no_std notes, and a
test-vector inventory. Claims I could not ground in a repo/file are marked **UNVERIFIED**.

## TL;DR — the SAFE allowlist (zero auth APDUs, default-deny everything else)

| # | Op | Exact APDU(s) | Expected | Grounding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Selected UID | *(no APDU — reader-side anti-collision UID)* | 7B UID (4B if random-ID mode) | ntag424 `session/mod.rs:135-155` |
| 1 | GetVersion (plain) | `90 60 00 00 00` → `90 AF 00 00 00` → `90 AF 00 00 00` | 7B + `91AF`, 7B + `91AF`, 14B + `9100` | ntag424 `commands/get_version.rs:27,89,91`; hw vector `:166-183` |
| 2 | SELECT NDEF app | `00 A4 04 00 07 D2 76 00 00 85 01 01 00` | `9000` | ntag424 `commands/iso_select_file.rs:12,96-98` (hw-validated `:91-105`) |
| 3 | SELECT CC file | `00 A4 00 0C 02 E1 03` | `9000` | ntag424 `iso_select_file.rs:63-64`, `types/file.rs:36-38`; nfcpy `tt4.py:237` |
| 4 | READ BINARY CC | `00 B0 00 00 02` (CCLEN), then `00 B0 <off> <len>` | CC bytes (factory CCLEN=0x0017) | nfcpy `tt4.py:239-257`; crate hw vector `iso_read_binary.rs:113-124` |
| 5 | SELECT NDEF file | `00 A4 00 0C 02 E1 04` | `9000` | ntag424 `session/unauthenticated.rs:483` |
| 6 | READ BINARY NDEF | `00 B0 00 00 00` (Le=00 → ≤256B); NLEN = first 2B BE | ≤256B, `9000`; `6982` if key-gated (safe failure) | ntag424 `iso_read_binary.rs:85,264-265`; nfcpy `tt4.py:285-310` |
| 7 | GetFileSettings (NDEF, plain) | `90 F5 00 00 01 02 00` | settings + `9100` | ntag424 `commands/get_file_settings.rs:16-28`; bolty diagnose `diagnose.rs:140-152` |
| 8 | Read_Sig (originality, plain) | `90 3C 00 00 01 00 00` | 56B + `9100`/`9190` | ntag424 `commands/read_sig.rs:13-31` |

Ops 0-8 write nothing, change no security state, and skip the auth subsystem entirely (bolty-rs
`docs/card-safety.md:40-59` §2: 'cannot brick, cannot trigger authentication delay'). Ops 7-8 are
native DESFire-style commands in plain CommMode; they fail harmlessly (`91AE`/`9140`-class errors)
on a misconfigured card. bolty-rs's `safe_inspect()` runs exactly ops 0-7 (plus local-only SDM
verification and a **second NDEF read** to distinguish Static vs Live SDM mirroring) with **zero
authentication APDUs** — `crates/bolty-ntag/src/lib.rs:257-320`.

**FORBIDDEN (default-deny):** every AUTH chain (`90 77…`/`90 71…`/`90 AF` after `91AF` from auth;
ntag424 `commands/authenticate/aes.rs:43,103,162`), `ChangeKey` `90 C4…` (`change_key.rs:119`),
`ChangeFileSettings` INS `5F` (`change_file_settings.rs:27`), `SetConfiguration` `90 5C…`
(`set_configuration.rs:21-24`), `ISOUpdateBinary` `00 D6…` (`iso_update_binary.rs:102`),
`WriteData` `90 8D…` (`write_data.rs:138,158`), and every MAC/FULL-mode command reachable only
after AUTH (GetCardUID `90 51…` `get_card_uid.rs:26`; GetKeyVersion `90 64…`; GetFileCounters
`90 F6…`; GetTTStatus `90 F7…`), plus both high-level flows `high_level::provision` /
`high_level::reset` (ntag424 `src/high_level/provision.rs:81-101`, `reset.rs:50-66`).

## 1. Amperstrand/ntag424 (fork of jannschu/ntag424) — `02f23f5`

Transport-agnostic Rust NTAG424 command layer; `no_std` with optional `alloc`
(`AGENTS.md:13-15`, README). Both downstream consumers (bolty-rs programmer, ccid-firmware-rs
reader) are 'hardware-verified with real NTAG 424 DNA cards' (`AGENTS.md:16-20`).

### (a) Reuse for a SAFE read-only Type-4 profile
- **ISO layer, byte-exact:** DF-name SELECT `00 A4 04 00 07 D2 76 00 00 85 01 01 00`
  (`commands/iso_select_file.rs:12` NDEF_APPLICATION_DF_NAME, §8.2.2; hw-validated test `:93-105`);
  EF SELECT `00 A4 00 0C 02 E1 03/04` (`iso_select_file.rs:58-71`, P2=0C suppresses FCI);
  READ BINARY `00 B0 P1 P2 Le` with 15-bit offset, SFID addressing `P1=0x80|SFID`, Le=00→256B cap
  (`commands/iso_read_binary.rs:13,54-85`). Chunked reader loop in
  `session/unauthenticated.rs:86-124` (256B/APDU, stops on short payload = file boundary).
- **Native plain-mode reads:** GetVersion (`get_version.rs:24-34`), GetFileSettings
  (`get_file_settings.rs:16-28`), Read_Sig (`read_sig.rs:13-31`, accepts both `9100` and `9190`).
- **CC semantics** (`types/cc.rs`): factory CC = T4T v2.0, MLe=256, MLc=255, NDEF file `E104`/256B
  READ=`00h` open, WRITE=`00h` open; Proprietary `E105`/128B READ=`82h` (key2), WRITE=`83h` (key3)
  (`types/cc.rs:141-160` Default impl + `:62-120` AccessCondition decode: `00h` open,
  `80h..84h` = key0..4, `FFh` denied). **Hw-confirmed:** unauthenticated read of E105 with
  ReadAccess=Key2 returns `6982` (`iso_read_binary.rs:264-265` test comment) — key-gated reads fail
  *safely and informatively*, they do not hang or burn state.
- **Factory NDEF file is 256 zero bytes** (`iso_read_binary.rs:170-189` hw-validated) — a good
  sanity signature for a blank card; factory proprietary file = `00 7E` length header + zeros
  (`session/unauthenticated.rs:380-390`, 'not documented in the public datasheet' — NXP-behavior
  note from hardware).
- **Failure semantics:** ISO errors surface as typed `SessionError::ErrorResponse`
  (6A82 = file/app not found, 6982 = security status not satisfied — `iso_read_binary.rs:191-207,
  259-280`), so an allowlist profile can classify refusals without retry loops.
- **Session-state guardrail worth copying:** re-selecting the NDEF app terminates authenticated
  state, so `select_ndef_application` is only exposed on `Session<Unauthenticated>`
  (`session/unauthenticated.rs:46-69`) — the type-state design itself enforces read-only usage.

### (b) Forbidden by our doctrine (present in this crate — do not wire into the reader profile)
AuthenticateEV2First AES/LRP (`commands/authenticate/aes.rs`, `lrp.rs`), ChangeKey
(`change_key.rs` — K0 loss is catastrophic, see bolty §3.1 below), ChangeFileSettings incl. SDM
configuration (`change_file_settings.rs`), SetConfiguration (`set_configuration.rs` — irreversible
options: LRP enable 'cannot be reverted' `types/configuration.rs:71-77`; tag-tamper enable cannot
be disabled `:115-121`; failed-auth-counter config `:127-142`), ISOUpdateBinary
(`iso_update_binary.rs` — also rejected while in authenticated state per §10.9.3, `:203`),
WriteData (`write_data.rs`), ReadData plain `90 AD` (`read_data.rs:143-166`) — read-only in
itself but native-file-scoped and unnecessary next to ISO READ BINARY, MAC variants everywhere in
`secure_channel.rs`. `check_factory_state()` (`session/unauthenticated.rs:283-420`) is the
canonical example of what NOT to run on an unknown card: it authenticates Key0/Key1-4 with
all-zero keys (multiple auth APDUs).

### (c) License + no_std
**MIT OR Apache-2.0** (`LICENSING.md`, root `Cargo.toml:7`) — permissive; linkable/vendorable into
GPL-2.0-or-later ccid-firmware-rs without license escalation. `no_std` + optional `alloc`
(README 'Usage', `AGENTS.md:40` `cargo build --no-default-features` = no_std contract). Fork carries
2 patches on branch `ai-experiments`: `Sdm::disabled()`, LenCap=0x03 auth fix (`LICENSING.md`
branch table; `AGENTS.md:43-47` warns auth fixtures are hardware-behavior statements).

### (d) Citations
All paths above relative to repo root at commit `02f23f51fc352f5abad8812550dc1e0361afe514`
(github.com/Amperstrand/ntag424). Upstream: codeberg.org/jannschu/ntag424 (local
`/root/src/ntag424-upstream` @ `f540830`, 2026-05-26).

## 2. Amperstrand/bolty-rs — `407625f`

Bolt-card programmer + vertical test rig; carries the line's deepest NTAG424 card-safety knowledge.

### (a) Reuse for the read-only profile
- **`docs/card-safety.md` is the doctrine document** (533 lines). §2 safe table: Read UID,
  GetVersion, GetFileSettings(NDEF), unauth NDEF read, local SDM PICC decrypt, local key
  derivation — 'zero risk of bricking' (`:40-59`). §1 state-detection heuristics: steps 1-4+6
  'completely safe (zero authentication APDUs)', step 5 (factory-K0 probe) 'increments the
  failed-auth counter' (`:26-36`).
- **`safe_inspect()`** (`crates/bolty-ntag/src/lib.rs:257-320`) — the exact zero-auth allowlist
  implementation: get_selected_uid → get_version (vendor 0x04/type 0x04 chip check,
  `lib.rs:242-253` incl. emulator carve-out: J3R180 applet omits GetVersion) →
  get_file_settings(NDEF) → read_file_unauthenticated(NDEF) → optional *local* SDM verify with
  caller keys → **read NDEF twice and compare** to classify SDM mirroring Static vs Live
  (`lib.rs:295-318`). On an unknown card the double-read is the cheapest SDM-liveness probe
  available without keys.
- **`diagnose`** (`apps/bolty-cli/src/diagnose.rs:1-14,100-165`) — non-destructive classifier
  (BLANK/PROVISIONED/HALF-WIPED/AUTH-DELAY/INCONSISTENT); every step degrades gracefully
  ('FAILED (e)' prints, `diagnose.rs:117-163`). Note `diagnose.rs:227-266`: the *full* diagnose
  includes one factory-K0 AES auth and even a deliberate wrong-key probe — **do not port that
  part**; `safe_inspect` is the safe subset.
- **Auth-delay knowledge:** NTAG424 has an internal failed-auth counter; AUTH-DELAY = `SeqFailCtr
  >= 50` (`crates/bolty-core/src/assessment.rs:51-55`); 'no permanent lockout observed from auth
  failures alone'; **measured 2026-08-26** (bounded experiment, blank card `04c474fa967380`):
  with a known-good key, auth succeeds instantly even after 1/2/3/5 wrong-key failures — the
  counter only punishes wrong-key retry *loops* (`docs/card-safety.md:189-216`).
- **Burn/wipe anatomy** (`docs/card-safety.md:130-185`): K0 changed LAST in both; the only
  unrecoverable event is K0 loss — §3.1 'PERMANENT BRICK... No recovery mechanism exists'
  (`:65-77`). Read this as the taxonomy of what our allowlist must make unreachable.

### (b) Forbidden per doctrine (documented here, implemented by bolty on purpose)
burn/wipe key installs (`apps/bolty-cli/src/burn.rs`, `wipe.rs`), SDM enable
(ChangeFileSettings), any factory-key probing (each failed probe feeds SeqFailCtr),
`try-key`/`scan-keys` recovery hunts (`docs/card-safety.md:390-393`).

### (c) License + no_std
**GPL-3.0-or-later** (crates' `Cargo.toml` license fields, e.g. `crates/bolty-core/Cargo.toml:5`;
root LICENSE = GPLv3 text). ⚠️ Copying bolty-rs *code* into GPL-2.0-or-later ccid-firmware-rs
forces the combined work to GPL-3.0+ (permitted by the 'or-later', but a project-policy decision);
the *doctrine and patterns* are facts, and `safe_inspect`'s logic is trivially re-expressible
against the permissively-licensed ntag424 crate. `bolty-ntag` is `#![no_std]` (comment in its
`Cargo.toml` deps, issue #111 note) — proof the ntag424 crate runs on embedded thumbv7em targets.

### (d) Citations
Paths relative to `/root/src/bolty-rs` @ `407625fa1436c38d3f7701f6f2322ed38868cd20`
(github.com/Amperstrand/bolty-rs). Worktrees at `/root/src/worktrees/bolty-rs/*` are branch
checkouts (not surveyed; main checkout is newer).

## 3. foundation-devices/ndef-rs — `8123db4`

### (a) Reuse — verdict: NOT suitable for the NTAG424 read path
- `#![no_std]` NDEF message codec (`src/lib.rs:4`), heapless fixed-capacity mode (8 records /
  256B payload without `alloc`, README 'Compatibility'), MSRV 1.87, `heapless = 0.9` with
  default-features off (`Cargo.toml:25,31`).
- **Fatal coverage gap:** the parser's well-known RTD match handles type string `"T"` (Text)
  only — `src/lib.rs:488` — every other well-known type returns `Error::UnsupportedRecordType`
  (`src/lib.rs:556`), and unknown TNFs return `UnsupportedTypeNameFormat` (`:578`). **A boltcard
  NDEF file is a TNF=1 URI ('U') record** → ndef-rs cannot parse it, and `RecordType` has no URI
  variant to express one (`src/lib.rs:152-161`: Text/External/Cbor only). It also has **no Type-4
  Tag mapping layer** (no CC read/select/NLEN handling — that lives in ntag424 `types/cc.rs` /
  ISO commands and in nfcpy `tt4.py`); 'T4 coverage' = none, by design (message-layer only).
- Independent corroboration: bolty-rs evaluated ndef-rs v0.5.0 and rejected it — 'KEEP our custom
  parser' (`/root/src/bolty-rs/docs/ndef-evaluation.md:1-27`): 4 extra deps (dcbor, derive_more,
  rustversion, heapless), wrapper needed for p=/c= extraction, 'overkill'.

### (b) Forbidden-ops angle
N/A — pure parsing library, no card interaction; nothing doctrine-relevant.

### (c) License + no_std
**GPL-3.0-or-later** (`Cargo.toml:9`, LICENSES/, SPDX header `README.md:1-4`, © Foundation
Devices). Same GPLv3 escalation consideration as bolty-rs if code were copied — moot given (a).
no_std: yes (default and `alloc`/`cbor` feature sets; `dcbor` drags std — README table).

### (d) Citations
github.com/foundation-devices/ndef-rs @ `8123db477ca1a51d6598b9b7931ae0af356a3418`;
`src/lib.rs:4,15,152-161,488,556,578`; `Cargo.toml:6-9,25,31`; README. Recommendation: for URI
NDEF, keep/reuse bolty's 55-line `parse_ndef_uri()` *pattern* (`bolty-ntag/src/lib.rs`,
bolty-rs `docs/ndef-evaluation.md:7-13`) re-implemented, or parse the TNF=1 'U' record directly
(prefix byte + URI) — trivial.

## 4. nfcpy — `8a19526` (v1.0.4)

### (a) Reuse — host-side ORACLE (Python), not firmware
- `src/nfc/tag/tt4.py` is a complete, battle-tested NFC Forum T4T read implementation and the
  best *semantic* reference for our profile: AIDs `D2760000850101` (v2) then `D2760000850100`
  (v1) fallback (`tt4.py:33-34,194-201`); SELECT FID with P2=0x0C under v2 AID (`:204-209`);
  READ/UPDATE BINARY with MLe/MLc clamping (`:211-219`); `_discover_ndef` (`:223-282`): select
  `E103`, read CCLEN(2B) then rest, validate mapping version 1/2/3, parse NDEF file-control TLV
  (tag 4 len 6 / tag 6 len 8), and derive `readable = (rf == 0)` / `writeable = (wf == 0)` —
  i.e. the T4T-sanctioned way to learn *from the CC* whether unauthenticated NDEF read is
  permitted; `_read_ndef_data` (`:285-310`): select NDEF FID from the CC TLV, read NLEN (2B BE,
  4B for v1), loop reads until NLEN satisfied.
- Use nfcpy on a bench host (e.g. with an ACR/PN7160 reader) as the behavioral oracle to diff
  our firmware's read-only session against a reference stack — same role the cashu-nfc matrix
  uses reference readers for.

### (b) Forbidden-ops angle
nfcpy also *writes* NDEF (`_update_binary`, `_write_ndef_data`, `tt4.py:320+`) and does card
format/encode — keep oracle scripts to the read path; nothing else doctrine-relevant.

### (c) License + no_std
**EUPL v1.1** (`LICENSE` header 'European Union Public Licence V. 1.1'; `setup.py:29` classifier).
Python — host-side only, never linked into firmware; EUPL↔GPL-2.0-or-later compatibility exists
via the EUPL appendix upgrade path, and is irrelevant for an unlinked oracle. Not no_std (CPython).

### (d) Citations
github.com/nfcpy/nfcpy @ `8a195262fe86167845d282ba5bc9cdaadf6441c4`; `src/nfc/tag/tt4.py` lines
as cited. Note: nfcpy 1.0.4 (2022) is the last PyPI release; repo quiescent since — pin it.

## 5. NXP PN7160 reference software — linux_libnfc-nci `449538e`

The NXPNFCProject org hosts Android NCI HAL drops; for a Linux/embedded NCI *stack* reference the
canonical PN7160 software is **NXPNFCLinux/linux_libnfc-nci** ('Linux NFC stack for NCI based NXP
NFC Controllers'; AN13287 documents it for PN7160 per the companion
NXPNFCLinux/linux_libnfc-nci_examples README). Kernel driver: NXPNFCLinux/nxpnfc (GPL-2.0, not
surveyed — **UNVERIFIED** beyond its README/license).

### (a) Reuse — NCI RF activation/deactivation timing reference
- **T4T reader constants:** `t4t_v20_ndef_tag_aid = D2 76 00 00 85 01 01`
  (`src/libnfc-nci/nfc/tags/tags_int.c:89`); CLA `00`, SELECT `A4` / READ BINARY `B0` / UPDATE
  BINARY `D6`, P1 select-by-name `04` / by-file-id `00`, P2 `00`/`0C`, max Le/Lc `0xFF`, RSP
  `9000`/`6A82` (`nfc/include/tags_defs.h:355-378`). NXP's reader state machine mirrors our
  profile: SUBSTATE WAIT_SELECT_APP → WAIT_SELECT_CC → … WAIT_SELECT_NDEF_FILE
  (`nfc/tags/rw_t4t.c:73-91`); CC validation accepts NDEF file id `0xE102`/`0xE103`
  (`rw_t4t.c:1065-1066`).
- **Timing constants (the ask):** per-APDU T4T response timeout `RW_T4T_TOUT_RESP = 1000 ms`
  (`src/libnfc-nci/include/nfc_target.h:330-334`, armed in `rw_t4t.c:154,2122`);
  deactivation wait `NFC_DEACTIVATE_TIMEOUT = 2 s` (`nfc_target.h:224-227`); NFA discovery
  wait-for-deactivate-NTF `NFA_DM_DISC_TIMEOUT_W4_DEACT_NTF = NFC_DEACTIVATE_TIMEOUT*1000 + 6000`
  = 8 s, with the design rationale in-source: 'possible delay to send deactivate CMD if all
  credit wasn't returned; transport delay (1sec) and max RWT (5sec)'
  (`src/libnfc-nci/nfa/int/nfa_dm_int.h:388-393`). CE-mode T4T frame-waiting `CE_T4T_ISO_DEP_FWI
  = 7` (`nfc_target.h:327-330`).
- **Deactivation semantics:** NCI deactivate types IDLE=0 / SLEEP=1 / SLEEP_AF=2 / DISCOVERY=3
  (`src/libnfc-nci/hal/include/nci_defs.h:344-347`); reasons DH_REQ=0 / ENDPOINT_REQ=1 /
  RF_LINK_LOSS=2 / NFCB_BAD_AFI=3 (`nci_defs.h:352-355`); NFA rule: deactivate-to-IDLE always
  allowed, SLEEP not for T1T/NFCDEP (`src/libnfc-nci/nfa/dm/nfa_dm_act.c:789-876`). The NCI core
  arms `deactivate_timer` when sending RF_DEACTIVATE_CMD (`nfc/nci/nci_hmsgs.c:1295-1312`) and
  stops it on completion (`nfc/nfc/nfc_main.c:386`).
- **Local counterpart already in-tree:** ccid-firmware-rs `crates/pn7160-nci` (GPL-2.0-or-later,
  `Cargo.toml:6`; ~8.2k LOC src) implements the NCI bring-up ladder CORE_RESET→CORE_INIT→
  SET_CONFIG (`src/driver.rs:231-234`), NXP-style two-phase NCI read (`src/esp_transport.rs:326`),
  and RF-link-loss deactivation handling (`src/driver.rs:1218,1453,1588,1652,1708`) — reuse the
  NXP numbers above as cross-checks for that crate's timeouts.

### (b) Forbidden-ops angle
N/A at NCI layer (transport only — safety lives at the APDU layer above). The stack does expose
T4T NDEF *write* paths (`rw_t4t.c` STATE_UPDATE_NDEF, `:64`) — do not enable for our profile.

### (c) License + no_std
**Apache-2.0** (`LICENSE.txt`) — permissive; constants/state-machine shapes copyable into any
license. C, not Rust/no_std; reference-only. Some NXP extensions are behind
`NFC_NXP_NOT_OPEN_INCLUDED` guards (`tags_defs.h:362-369`) — treat guarded code as not-open.

### (d) Citations
github.com/NXPNFCLinux/linux_libnfc-nci @ `449538e5e106666e5263afeaddacc5836fc23d3f`; files/lines
above. Task named org 'NXPNFCProject' — that org hosts the Android NCI drops (e.g.
NFC_NCIHAL_libnfc-nci) and NXPNFC_Reference; for Linux PN7160 the NXPNFCLinux forks above are the

## 6. Proposed SAFE read-only NTAG424 Type-4 session (normative)

Preconditions: ISO-DEP activated (PN7160 RF_INTERFACE_ACTIVATED), fresh connection, SW watchdog
per APDU (bench doctrine). Sequence (every step optional-after-failure, NO retries on auth-class
status words):

1. `get_selected_uid` (reader UID; zero APDU) — if 4B, card is in random-ID mode (ntag424
   `session/mod.rs:135-155`): expected for a provisioned boltcard, still safe.
2. `90 60 00 00 00` / `90 AF 00 00 00` ×2 → decode HW/SW/production; assert vendor `04` type `04`
   (bolty `lib.rs:242-253`) before anything else. `91AE` here ⇒ AUTH-DELAYED card ⇒ STOP.
3. `00 A4 04 00 07 D2 76 00 00 85 01 01 00` → `9000`.
4. `00 A4 00 0C 02 E1 03`; `00 B0 00 00 02` → CCLEN; `00 B0 00 02 <cclen-2>` → CC. Decode per
   `types/cc.rs`: NDEF entry READ byte decides whether step 6 is permitted at all (`00h` open,
   `8xh` key-gated, `FFh` denied — nfcpy `tt4.py:272-277` uses exactly this to set 'readable').
5. `90 F5 00 00 01 02 00` → file settings; SDM fields present ⇒ provisioned card (bolty
   `diagnose.rs:140-152`). `91 9E`/plain-refusal ⇒ card forbids plain CommMode ⇒ STOP, report.
6. `00 A4 00 0C 02 E1 04`; `00 B0 00 00 00` → NLEN(2B BE) + NDEF message. Read twice, diff ⇒
   Static vs Live SDM mirroring (bolty `lib.rs:295-318`). `6982` ⇒ NDEF read is key-gated: safe
   terminal answer ('NDEF locked'), NOT an error to retry.
7. (optional) `90 3C 00 00 01 00 00` → 56B originality sig; verify offline with NXP master key
   (ntag424 `crypto/originality.rs`, `read_sig.rs:13-31`).

Then **DEACTIVATE to IDLE** (NFA semantics, `nfa_dm_act.c:803-816`), honoring the NXP timing
budgets (§5a): 1 s per-APDU watchdog (RW_T4T_TOUT_RESP), up to 8 s allowance for deactivate-NTF
under credit/RWT delays. Anything not in steps 1-7 → default-deny.

## 7. Test-vector inventory

- ntag424 unit tests (hw-validated, per test comments): plain GetVersion 3-frame vector incl.

  (`:314-394`); SELECT AID/select-error vectors (`iso_select_file.rs:91-121`); READ BINARY
  factory-CC payload + 256-zero NDEF + `6A82`/`6982` error paths (`iso_read_binary.rs:108-280`);
  AN12196 §5.5/§5.6 published handshake vectors (`get_version.rs:185-198`).

  `/root/src/ntag424-vectors/README.md`). All are **offline crypto** vectors (CMAC/SDM/derivation)
